results.title: Di Cavalcanti
results.overview: Di Cavalcanti was the first Brazilian artist to truly capture the face of Brazil. He spent his life portraying the country with courage and originality. From the creation of Brazil’s first Modern Art Week in 1922 to the 1960s and 1970s, his work became a familiar presence in Brazilian homes, eventually reaching an international audience. His creativity, freedom, excesses, and suffering found expression in his paintings. Guided by pleasure and wisdom, Di experienced both pain and glory. Di is, indeed, Brazilian!

results.title: Remedy for an Ordinary Life
results.overview: Memory exists beyond time. It fragments, overlaps, and makes us who we are. And in life, change is the only constant.  Remedy for an Ordinary Life is a mirror of what it's like to try and comprehend change. It goes back and forth in time, between old childhood tapes recorded by Filmmaker Nancy Nanda’s parents, and her turning the lens back onto them, decades later.

results.title: Embers Across The Tides
results.overview: Xiaojing, a bright 16-year-old girl, longs to escape her small town and suffocating home, develops a fascination for Yixin—a stylish, intelligent tutor who returns from the big city after losing her job.

results.title: Minute by minute
results.overview: In Harbor City, Lan buys a costly battery-water plan for her grandson. The water ruins his health and memory, but right after, the government makes it free, leaving Lan trapped in her contract.

results.title: THE BOWL
results.overview: Investigating a staged suicide at a grim apartment, a detective finds a diary naming the real killer. As he records his findings and describes the suspect, he is ambushed from behind and shot in the back.

results.title: Spilling Your Guts
results.overview: An original poem turned short film and performance art piece. It emerges from the experience of becoming completely exposed when meeting someone you connect with deeply. It is the frantic realization that the baggage you have carried for years, once manageable, now sits in the middle of the room that exists between you and another person. Under their gaze, its weight changes.

results.title: Our Dark Horse
results.overview: An intimate vérité portrait of a former racehorse rescued from slaughter, whose journey back to herself reveals the powerful ties of herd and motherhood—and the inner lives of horses beyond sport.

results.title: The Dong Goblin
results.overview: Despite the warnings of a caring mother, Ashwin can’t resist the temptation of self pleasure. His actions catch the eye of the sinister Dong Goblin who teaches Ashwin a lesson he won’t soon forget.
